data.title: 生盐诺亚 · 深夜独处时的心跳低语
data.description: 只有床头一盏暖黄色小夜灯亮着的静谧卧房。诺亚换上了轻薄的深紫色真丝吊带睡裙，纯白的长发散落在光洁的肩头。她微微前倾凑近老师耳畔，白皙脸颊泛着淡淡红晕，平日里从容无懈可击的书记官，此刻展现出毫无防备的脆弱与动情。
data.location: quiet dim master bedroom beside bed
data.action: leaning close, whispering softly, deep purple silk nightgown, gentle blush
data.lighting: soft golden bedside night lamp casting warm intimate shadows
data.mood: deep vulnerable tenderness and whispered affection
data.promptProse: Leaning close beside a soft mattress in warm dim bedside light, Ushio Noa wears a delicate purple silk slip nightgown, blushing softly with an alluring, defenseless gaze.
data.animaCaption: Noa sitting close on the bed in a silk slip nightdress.
